claim: The hybrid system improves most on paraphrases and bilingual queries, while BM25 remains competitive for exact names, codes, and titles.
evidence: On the corrected split, BM25 achieves recall@10 of 0.69, MRR of 0.52, and median latency of 74 ms. The hybrid system reaches recall@10 of 0.80, MRR of 0.63, and latency of 182 ms.

claim: BM25 should remain the basic baseline, with hybrid fusion used as the main baseline.
evidence: For queries containing exact identifiers, BM25 slightly outperforms the hybrid system.
